scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @sekereagle/config && npm run build --workspace @sekereagle/api && npm run build --workspace @sekereagle/worker && npm run build --workspace @sekereagle/web && npm run build --workspace @sekereagle/contracts
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @sekereagle/config && npm run typecheck --workspace @sekereagle/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @sekereagle/worker && npm run typecheck --workspace @sekereagle/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @sekereagle/contracts
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @sekereagle/config && npm run test --workspace @sekereagle/api && npm run test --workspace @sekereagle/worker && npm run test --workspace @sekereagle/web && npm run test --workspace @sekereagle/contracts
scripts.db:migrate:deploy: npm run db:guard && npm run prisma:migrate:deploy --workspace @sekereagle/api
scripts.contracts:generate: npm run openapi:generate --workspace @sekereagle/api && npm run generate --workspace @sekereagle/contracts && prettier --write packages/contracts/openapi.json packages/contracts/src/generated/openapi.ts
scripts.contracts:check: npm run contracts:generate && git diff --exit-code -- packages/contracts/openapi.json packages/contracts/src/generated/openapi.ts
scripts.ci:check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run format:check
